pm.test("201 and created task", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const task = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(task.id).to.match(/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i); pm.expect(task.title).to.eql("B8 homework"); pm.expect(task.status).to.eql("open"); pm.expect(task.priority).to.eql("normal"); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.eql("/tasks/" + task.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("task_id", task.id); });

pm.test("200 and expected task", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const task = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(task.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("task_id")); pm.expect(task.title).to.eql("B8 homework"); });

pm.test("200 and updated status", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const task = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(task.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("task_id")); pm.expect(task.status).to.eql("done"); pm.expect(task.title).to.eql("B8 homework"); });

pm.test("200 and status filter", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(body.total).to.be.at.least(1); body.items.forEach(task => pm.expect(task.status).to.eql("done")); pm.expect(body.items.length).to.be.at.most(100); });
pm.test("204 and empty body", () => { pm.response.to.have.status(204); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(""); });

pm.test("Problem JSON", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/problem+json"); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(404); ["type", "title", "detail"].forEach(key => pm.expect(body[key]).to.be.a("string")); });

pm.test("Problem JSON", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/problem+json"); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(401); ["type", "title", "detail"].forEach(key => pm.expect(body[key]).to.be.a("string")); });
